name: After § 39
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 39a. Rejects the allocation of budgetary appropriations for militarism, including for war, armaments, military infrastructure, capacity and mobility; rejects the ongoing escalation of militarisation of the EU; calls for the reallocation of funds from the EU budget for militarisation programmes, reallocating them to support Member States in improving the economic and social situation on the basis of the principle of economic and social cohesion, i.e. achieving convergence in economic and social progress;
